description: This PHP source file defines the ServerRequestCreator class which implements methods to create PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface objects from global variables or arrays, encapsulating the logic to parse server environment variables, headers, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and request body to build server request objects.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreator
classes.description: A final class implementing server request creation from PHP global variables and arrays, adhering to PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequestInterface object based on PHP's global variables like $_SERVER, $_COOKIE, $_GET, $_POST, $_FILES, and php://input stream.

methods.name: fromArrays
methods.description: Constructs a ServerRequestInterface object from provided arrays simulating server environment, headers, cookies, query, post data, uploaded files, and body stream.

methods.name: getHeadersFromServer
methods.description: Static method that extracts HTTP headers from server environment variables following the CGI/Apache conventions.
